question: Each 100 g added to a running shoe raises energy cost by about 1%. How many extra grams per shoe would cancel a 4% saving?
move: Put a percentage into a unit you can hold in your hand.
hint: Count how many of the 1% penalties fit inside the saving.
steps: Each 100 g on each shoe costs about 1% more energy.
A 4% saving is four of those 1% steps.
